headline: An allergy complaint needs a call today, and Rs. 7200 + Rs. 950 + Rs. 1800 in refunds are unresolved, while yesterday's sales were up 67.5%.

urgent.why: She was taken to hospital after eating the walnut brownies. She is allergic to hazelnuts and he wants the full ingredient list today. Check the recipe, give him the exact ingredients, and fix the allergen info on the Instagram post.

urgent.item: Approve or decide on refund CB-1201, Rs. 7200
urgent.why: Corporate brownie order reported stale. It is waiting for your approval, and it is a health and quality issue as well as money owed.
Pending since 26 Sep. She was promised 3 to 5 days and this is her third email.

urgent.why: He sent photos and wants a full refund. It is not in the support queue yet, so it could be missed.

urgent.item: Send Vikram (TechSoft) the quote for 120 brownies (60 classic, 60 eggless) with GST invoice
urgent.why: He asked for it by Wednesday, which is today. Event is on 17 Oct, budget about Rs. 60 per piece.
